title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the average pressure p as given in the reference solution.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the relationship for (partial epsilon_s / partial V)_N as shown in the reference solution.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the pressure p in terms of U and V as given in the reference solution.

title: Correct Use of Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the partition function Z to the pressure p in part (a).

title: Energy Dependence on Volume
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of how energy states depend on volume in part (b).

title: Substitution in (c)
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute the result from (b) into (a) to derive (c).

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors when deriving relationships between pressure and energy.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.
